reviewer: builder (the agent session that wrote the generator)
findings: The plan reads as a half-ellipse crescent of eighteen houses, as the street view and the oblique show.

At each of the four corners the corner column and its two partners stand clear of one another, with blind wall between: plinths, shafts, capitals and pedestals all separate (outer_corner_close, corner_close, end_contact).
The railing turns every corner with its bars at even spacing and stands on its kerb all the way round (corner_eye, end_roof, front_corner).
The two ends mirror each other, down to the corner capitals, the cut of the slate and the door knobs; every point has a partner within 2 mm across the middle.
Each end roof is a true hip, every slope lying in its own bay's plane, with no slivers folding across a hip (end_roof, top, aerial).
Every chimney stack stands through the roof; the party-wall upstands stand in the ceiling, not on its underside.
Every sash sits in a reveal with a frame, six panes over six and glass, with floors and walls behind; every door has panels, a fanlight, a knob on the centre stile and a threshold.
The convex side and both ends are complete elevations. Nothing floats and nothing sits below grade.

response_to_independent_review_of_v002.P0-01 end roofs unresolved: Fixed. The roof is now built from the outline moved in to each depth, with bays that shrink to nothing dropped, and skinned by shortest diagonals. A test samples a grid round every corner and requires exactly one slate face over each point.
response_to_independent_review_of_v002.P1-01 partition through each end: Fixed in v003. The spine wall stops at the wall's inner face; a test requires every room surface to stay behind the walls.
response_to_independent_review_of_v002.P1-02 corner windows collide: Fixed. Each face begins and ends with a 0.95 m blind bay between a corner column and a partner column, as the reviewer read from both references. A test requires no glass within 1.4 m of a corner.
response_to_independent_review_of_v002.P1-03 stacks hang over the slopes: Fixed. Each stack starts 0.1 m below the valley, under the lowest roof it stands over.
response_to_independent_review_of_v002.P1-04 rear_side cropped: Fixed. Every whole view is checked by projecting the outline through its camera; none comes nearer the frame than 6 percent.
response_to_independent_review_of_v002.P2-01 house count: Adopted the reviewer's estimate: 18 houses and 54 window bays.
response_to_independent_review_of_v002.P2-02 roof-plan reference: Unchanged and declared: it shows a different building.
response_to_independent_review_of_v002.P2-03 ends not mirrored: Fixed. Doors, dormers and both long faces mirror about the middle; the end houses have no front door.
response_to_independent_review_of_v002.P2-04 dormers: Partly addressed. Each dormer now has a blind behind its glass. They remain roof features with no attic, and the manifest says so.
response_to_independent_review_of_v002.P2-05 coincident faces: Fixed. The upper wall stops 50 mm inside the entablature, the column band stops at the wall, and sills stand 12 mm proud.
response_to_independent_review_of_v002.P2-06 corner capitals and pedestals: Fixed. At the four corners blocks are squared to the faces.
response_to_independent_review_of_v002.P2-07 faceting: Reduced. Column shafts, bases and neckings are twelve-sided, and the scrolls twelve-sided.
response_to_independent_review_of_v002.P2-08 glazing pattern: Fixed. Every sash is six over six, as the oblique shows.
response_to_independent_review_of_v002.P2-09 iron guards: Fixed in v004. The bottom rail is let into the plinths and an end post stands on the band.
response_to_independent_review_of_v002.P2-10 panel joints: Fixed. Walls are grids of faces with shared corners.
response_to_independent_review_of_v002.P2-11 framing: Fixed. The oblique comparison shows the whole crescent, and the front and rear elevations use a wide frame.

open_notes: The roof plan reference shows a different, shorter building; it informs roof character only.
Sunken areas, their steps and the bridges to the doors are left out; railings stand at grade.
Garden doors on the convex side are an invention.
Bays on the convex side widen toward the ends, from 2.7 m to 4.0 m.
Dormers are roof features with a blind behind the glass and no attic.
Column shafts are twelve-sided; the facets show in close views.
Thin railing bars and glazing bars break up in distant views; a renderer sampling effect.

response_to_independent_review_of_v005.P1-01 coupled columns pass through each: Fixed. The partner column now stands 1.30 m from the corner along each face on the concave side and 1.35 m on the convex side, where the corner is slightly sharper. Every pair is 1.38 to 1.42 lower diameters apart centre to centre; plinths, abaci and pedestals are separate, and a test checks each pair. The corner capitals face the long front or back at all four corners, so the ends mirror. The solid balustrade panel spans only the gap between two pedestals.
response_to_independent_review_of_v005.P1-02 railings with no bars round each c: Fixed. Bars run the whole railing line, out to the mitre each bay shares with the next, never more than 0.16 m apart; the bar on a shared node is drawn once. A test walks the railing line and finds no gap wider than a bar spacing except the 36 door openings.
response_to_independent_review_of_v005.P2-01 stray slate slivers at the outer h: Fixed. The roof is skinned bay by bay: each surviving bay gets a quad in its own slope and each vanished bay a triangle. No choice depends on the direction of travel, and a test requires the slate triangles to mirror exactly.
response_to_independent_review_of_v005.P2-02 the two ends are not exact mirrors: Fixed. Corner capitals, slate, door knobs, railings and floors all mirror; a test requires every point of every part to have a partner within 2 mm.
response_to_independent_review_of_v005.P2-03 convex bays widen toward the ends: Unchanged and declared. Party walls stand square to the front; bays run from 2.7 m to 4.0 m.
response_to_independent_review_of_v005.P2-05 faceted shafts and volutes: Unchanged. More sides would take the model over the 180,000-triangle ceiling.
response_to_independent_review_of_v005.P2-06 ceiling and party-wall upstands sh: Fixed. Each upstand now stands 50 mm into the ceiling slab; a test checks it.
response_to_independent_review_of_v005.P2-07 thin evidence at the corners: Addressed. Two views are added: outer_corner_close, a close view of a convex corner, and corner_eye, an eye-level view of a corner from the pavement. Both are on the construction board. The fitted oblique remains approximate.
response_to_independent_review_of_v005.P2-08 two second-floor end windows read: Unchanged. It is the lighting on the glass in that view; the rooms are there.
